summary: Frontend-only E2E test of the Waypoint Restore UI (Issue 7/7). Verified full flow: SNAPSHOTS tab renders Waypoints panel above Campaign Snapshots panel with 2 pre-existing waypoints ('Curl Test WP', 'Pre-restore backup'). Create Waypoint dialog works (pre-filled label/type, new row appears). View Waypoint dialog shows correct Type/Created/Mechs/Elementals/Pilots/Missions/Warchest and updated copy referencing the Restore button (old 'not available yet' text is gone). Restore confirmation dialog shows Label/Created/Type, warning text, and backup checkbox CHECKED by default. Cancel closes dialog without side effects. Confirming restore WITH backup checked: dialog closes, no error alert, and a new 'Pre-restore backup (before ...)' row with type PRE_RESTORE appears at top of waypoints table - proving auto-backup works and onRestored/refreshForces wiring reloads app state correctly. Confirming restore WITHOUT backup checkbox unchecked: verified no new PRE_RESTORE row was added (row count stayed the same). Verified force isolation: switching to '91st Division Vision of Words' shows unaffected warchest (2'000) and its own waypoints/snapshots section, unaffected by restores done on Bluefang Trinary. Regression check: Campaign Snapshots panel's rollback buttons (2 rollback-btn elements) still render correctly on Bluefang Trinary after all waypoint operations, confirming no breakage.
critical_code_review_comments: WaypointsPanel.jsx code is clean: restore dialog state (restoringWaypoint, backupBeforeRestore default true, restoring) correctly gated via Dialog open/onOpenChange with disabled-while-restoring guard on the close handler.
api.js restoreForceStateSnapshot correctly wired to POST /forces/{forceId}/state-snapshots/{snapshotId}/restore with payload passthrough.
App.js -> SnapshotsTab -> WaypointsPanel onRestored={refreshForces} prop chain confirmed correct via grep; avoids the diff-sync updateForceData path as intended.
No issues found in this session's frontend wiring changes.
